role: City planning staff conducting community meetings

summary: Los Angeles City Planning staff conducted four rounds of community meetings throughout the Regional Core in coordination with SCRTD staff as part of the Community Participation Program. Their role was facilitative — organizing and running public outreach — rather than advocating for or against any particular alternative. No independent position or complaint is attributed to them.
